text: You booked ten fucking calls this week, right?
style: Cheeky and mocking, quick, like a best friend about to roast you.

text: Ten, bro. So booked I'm taking calls from my car.
style: Hyped and proud, bragging to his buddy, a casual American guy.
Flat and deadpan, a trap question.
Sheepish on 'Okay, zero', then quickly defensive and upbeat.

text: Great conversations. Forty minutes in, you finally ask the budget.
style: Dry and slow, repeating his words with sarcasm, then matter-of-fact.

text: And they all go, "I was thinking like fifty bucks?"
style: Exasperated venting, then imitating a lead in a small, unsure voice on the quote.

text: That's not sales. That's free consulting from a parked car.
style: A mocking roast, slow and smug, savoring the last words.

text: Bro, maybe I just suck at closing.
style: Deflated and quiet, doubting himself, venting to a friend.

text: You don't suck. Your link books people who were never buying.
style: Firm and warm on the first sentence, then dead serious and slow on the second.

text: Then how do I know before they book?
style: Curious and a bit desperate, leaning in.

text: Plug me into ManyChat. I ask your questions in the DM, one at a time.
style: Smooth and confident, a sly little offer, calm and easy.

text: And the ones who literally can't pay?
No calendar. They get your free guide or your cheaper offer.
style: Calm and cheeky, a quick 'No calendar', then easy and generous.
Worried, voice going up at the end.

text: Fewer calls. Serious ones. With their answers right in the invite.
style: Confident and smug, three short beats, savoring the last one.

text: Okay, I'm in. My next call's in two minutes.
style: Convinced and rushed, glancing at his phone, a bit stressed on the second sentence.

text: Take it. Spoiler, he's thinking like fifty fucking bucks.
style: Mocking, laughing at him, slow and smug.

text: Comment SETTY and I'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
style: Smooth and smug, then warm and generous on the offer, like handing over a gift.
